source: Phase 5 starter item bank (+ v5: resume upload PRF-00; video option on WC-01; document option on the case) for the 7 forms (original wording). Talent DNA options carry maps_to (TDD §9.1 dimensions) and rank_points 4-3-2-1; values items carry value_map (TDD §9.2) on a 6-point portrait scale; capability items carry competency_map + correct_option. Scoring metadata is never sent to candidates. Edit in Admin → Questions.

Write a memo (250–400 words) — or record a 2–5 minute video — for the Chief Operating Officer of a mid-sized logistics company. Late deliveries rose from 4% to 11% in the six months after a new warehouse system went live. Recommend what the company should do in the next 90 days. Lead with your recommendation, give three supporting points, and name one risk and how you would manage it.
Structure the problem. Set out the key question, your issue tree or main hypotheses, and the analyses you would run first (and why).
Give your recommendation. Compare at least two options, recommend one, and set out the main risks, how you would manage them, and how you would measure success.
